main_measure.name: mean unusual 3-bar move of the cases, taken long

statistic.name: t of the mean, cases of one day taken together

main_measure.threshold: t >= 2 confirms (with positive size difference), t <= -2 rejects, otherwise inconclusive

supporting_check.name: mean unusual move of cases with forecast >= median minus those below (Welch t) [Welch t = -0.375]

decided_by: The t of the unusual move is between -2 and 2.
reading: The falling calm profile is the recorded regime 'unknown'; a case is the first bar in each 3-bar grid cell (from each window's first row) where the forecast rose by at least 2 points from its lowest level since its last bet (from 0 after a flat), the drift is the mean 3-bar return on that grid over all the coin's windows, and the day-clustered standard error uses the per-day summed deviations with a D/(D-1) correction.

effect_check.why: t in the idea's direction +1.887 (not below 1), 503 cases (30 needed)
